item.title: 实现特定领域的原子模型：固体酸系列的机器学习潜力
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jonas Hänseroth, Rose Asuka Baroness von Stackelberg, Christian Dreßler
在整个元素周期表中训练的机器学习原子间势使得原子模拟变得更加容易实现，并且人们普遍期望将它们专门针对单个化合物类别以提高准确性。然而例子仍然很少，而且在速度上超越通用模型或达到电子结构理论更高水平的例子仍然很少。在这里，我们提出了一种在无水固态氢键网络介导的质子导体类中普遍存在的潜力，而不是在化学领域中普遍存在的潜力，以及涵盖 55 种材料的 440 万个第一原理配置的数据库。它超越了该领域领先的通用潜力，恢复了这些模型遗漏的测量活化能和阴离子旋转动力学的顺序；

arXiv:2609.39984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are essential components for accelerating simulation-driven materials design. Data-efficient MLIP training relies on data-selection strategies that maximize structural diversity while limiting computationally expensive first-principles calculations. A key challenge in such strategies is evaluating structural similarity, which involves a trade-off between retaining information on individual atomic environments and reducing computational cost. Here, we propose similarity evaluation methods that achieve both representational fidelity and computational efficiency. arXiv:2609.39773v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Crystal structure governs material properties, making crystal structure prediction (CSP) a fundamental problem in materials science. Generative models are a promising approach for solving this problem, but the prevalence of polymorphism, coupled with large unit cells and complex packing geometry, makes the molecular CSP task challenging for existing models. CG-OMatG predicts molecular crystal structures via a coarse-grained, hierarchical representation. 👤 Xiang Xin, Rui Li, Fucheng Liu, Fengyun Lu
The engineering demand for lightweighting in police protective equipment is fundamentally a constrained multi-objective optimization problem, requiring balanced trade-offs among protective performance, functional performance, durability, and manufacturing constraints. Conventional trial-and-error design approaches for high-performance fiber-reinforced composites—such as ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE), aramid, and carbon fiber systems—are costly and inefficient due to complex multi-parameter interactions governing ballistic limit velocity (V₅₀) and back-face signature (BFS). This study presents a systematic machine learning (ML)-driven framework for lightweight material design tailored to law enforcement protective gear. Machine-learning-based inverse design can accelerate the discovery of materials with targeted properties, but conventional structure--property models often require large training datasets and generalize poorly beyond their training distribution. By combining a short dynamical initialization with physics-based refinement during simulation, the framework enables optimization well beyond the conditions represented in the training data. arXiv:2608.01750v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The existence of an ideal MagnetoHydroDynamic (MHD) equilibrium does not guarantee its stability. AGNI discretizes the ideal MHD energy principle pseudospectrally in real space using differentiation matrices and geometric coefficients from a DESC equilibrium, giving a variational eigenvalue problem for the plasma displacement, and efficiently finds the most unstable modes. item.title: 用于分层贝叶斯时间采样的可变性感知忆阻器电路
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Tarcisius Januel, Tifenn Hirtzlin, Olivier Billoint, Djohan Bonnet, Louis Hutin, Damien Querlioz 等8位作者
贝叶斯神经网络（ BNN ）需要能够存储和采样概率突触权重的硬件。虽然群体编码利用设备到设备（ D2D ）的可变性来编码权重分布，但时间采样相反需要受控和可重复的随机波动，使其硬件实现特别具有挑战性。在这里，我们演示了一种基于忆阻器的时间编码电路，该电路将每个突触权重的三个模拟忆阻器器件结合起来，以编码其均值和标准偏差，并使用外部注入的白噪声源进行样本生成。

item.title: 二维 CeN 的第一性原理研究：结构稳定性、电子结构和磁性之间的相互作用
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jose Mario Galicia Hernandez, Jose Jorge Rios Ramirez, Gregorio Hernandez Cocoletzi, Juan Francisco Rivas Silva
在这项工作中，利用第一性原理计算研究了源自块状岩盐 CeN（111）表面的新型 CeN 单层的结构稳定性以及电子和磁性。尺寸减小会导致局域原子环境发生显着变化，将 Ce-N 配位从块体中的六倍减少到单层中的三倍，并缩短 Ce-N 键长，同时保留基本平面的六方结构。此外，电子和磁性能得到显着改变，这可能对实际应用有用。研究了铁磁（FM）和反铁磁（AFM）构型，发现它们具有很强的束缚性，FM态的能量略低。磁矩主要集中在 Ce 原子上，并且主要源自 Ce 4f 态。

item.title: 自旋双折射和跨 p 波交变磁异质结构的自旋偏振传输
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yong-Mei Zhang, Zhi-Ping Niu
本文研究了 N/AM 界面或 N/AM/N 异质结的电子传输特性。基于三个区域的哈密顿量，提出了一般波函数并构造了组合线性方程。获得了交流磁体异质结构的反射和透射系数以及自旋极化。当电子从普通金属入射到交变磁体时，它被散射并分裂成+分支和_分支，传输到具有不同折射角的交变磁体区域。全内反射可能发生在+分支上。全反射的临界角由入射条件和增材制造材料的特性决定。在异质结构情况下，自旋向上和自旋向下的电子以相同的传播方向传输，但传输概率不同。传输和偏振随着结的长度而周期性地变化。

item.title: Holey石墨烯中出现的量子几何相
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Pablo Canteli, Yuriko Baba, Juan Salvador-Sánchez, Jorge Estrada-Álvarez, Ana Pérez-Rodríguez, Carlos Sánchez-Sánchez 等14位作者
在石墨烯和其他二维材料中，电子密度的周期性调制可以显着改变能谱和传输特性。在这里，我们报告了封装单层石墨烯中的磁输运测量，该石墨烯具有超高质量图案化周期性反点晶格，可保留材料的固有电子特性。这种光刻定义的平台能够以其他方式难以实现的长度尺度来受控地访问可通约性和超晶格现象。通过系统地调整晶格尺寸，我们揭示了由具有可比较半径的回旋加速器轨道产生的经典可通约性特征的层次结构，这些轨道遵循多个经典轨迹，从而导致超出传统单轨道图的更宽的电阻峰值。

item.description:

👤 Michael Liudeng, Hrishikesh Patel, Marcel Franz, Niclas Heinsdorf
Fully gapped spin-triplet superconductors offer a natural setting for topological edge transport and Majorana excitations. Here we propose a heterostructure that interfaces altermagnetic monolayer V2Se2O with a conventional s-wave superconductor. Starting from an ab-initio description of V2Se2O, we construct a low-energy model of its spin-split Fermi surface and study the superconducting instability of the coupled stack. We find that the momentum-dependent exchange splitting of the altermagnet strongly favorsequal-spin pairing and converts the proximity-induced order into a fully gapped p-wave state.
